minor.issue: Returns 400 with 'Image couldn't be processed. Please use a clear photo.' instead of the spec-specified 'Image is too large. Please use a smaller photo.' Endpoint still correctly rejects with 400 (never a 500 or hang), so functionally safe. Root cause likely that oversized 'A'*15000001 payload fails base64 decode ordering before size guard fires. Not user-facing since the frontend enforces client-side image size limits before uploading.

Returns 200 instead of 400/422 for empty-string body. Backend produces a graceful chatbot response. Frontend disables Send when input is empty, so this is not user-reachable; recommend adding server-side min-length validation for defense-in-depth (non-blocking for App Store).

rca_of_issue: No bugs found in the two App-Store fixes. Both fixes verified end-to-end via `npx expo config --type introspect`: (a) Fix 1 works because expo-camera plugin config { microphonePermission:false, recordAudioAndroid:false } instructs the plugin to skip injecting NSMicrophoneUsageDescription/RECORD_AUDIO; expo-image-picker { microphonePermission:false } prevents its default mic injection. Introspect output confirms all three suppressions active. (b) Fix 2 works because ios.requireFullScreen:true translates directly to UIRequiresFullScreen:true in Info.plist, and Expo's default orientation:'portrait' produces [Portrait, PortraitUpsideDown] only, with no iPad-specific landscape override. Combination lets the iPad still be a valid install target (supportsTablet:true) but locks the runtime UI to portrait as the App Store reviewer required.
